key_idea: Keep the first number of the current round; the first later number divisible by it ends the round.
sketch: Scan the sequence with a variable holding the round's first number (0 = no round open). If no round is open, the current number opens one; otherwise if it is a multiple, print it and close the round. O(n). Pitfall: the number that ends a round is not the start of the next one, and a trailing incomplete round prints nothing.
